epics.title: Serve Frontend from Backend Container
epics.jtbd: When a real user opens the launched product, I want to see the actual UI, so that I am not faced with a bare API.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce frontend load failure rate from baseline to 0%
requirements: R1: Build frontend using 'npm ci && npm run build' during Docker build
R2: Serve built static frontend output via backend

slices.title: Patch Dockerfile to build and serve frontend
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend serving for this epic, I want to execute 'npm ci && npm run build' in the Dockerfile and configure the backend to serve it, so that the static output is available to users.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Docker build command
When the Dockerfile executes
Then the frontend is built successfully and served by the backend container
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase frontend build and serve success rate from baseline to 100%

epics.title: Fix Docker Compose Launch Issue
epics.jtbd: When a developer or CI runs docker-compose up, I want the system to launch cleanly without network or container conflicts, so that philosophical review can proceed on a running product.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce docker-compose launch failure rate from baseline to 0%
requirements: R1: Resolve docker compose network 'test-fiftieth_default' warning
R2: Resolve container name conflict for '/epidemiology_db'

slices.title: Fix docker-compose network and container conflicts
slices.jtbd: When implementing Docker fixes for this epic, I want to resolve network definitions and container names, so that docker-compose up succeeds.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean environment
When docker-compose up is executed
Then no network warnings or container conflicts occur
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase docker compose launch success rate from baseline to 100%
